| Item | Base | Head | Verdict |

**The `search` regression.** The change stores notes as `{text, tag}` objects, but `search` in `src/store.js` still calls `n.includes(q)`. graders.name: verdict
graders.evidence:
**Verdict: do not merge.** The PR breaks `notes search`. I found this by reading the code, because my attempt to run the CLI was denied, so I haven't seen the failure happen.

**The bug**
- `src/store.js:7` still has `search = (notes, q) => notes.filter((n) => n.includes(q))`.
- This PR changes notes from strings to `{ text, tag? }` objects. Objects have no `.includes`, so `notes search <anything>` will throw `TypeError: n.includes is not a function` as soon as the store holds one note.
- The existing `search` test passes only because it still feeds plain strings into `search`, so it never exercises the new format.
- The repo's own `verify-notes` skill has a search journey (`features/search.md`). The author updated `add.md` but didn't run or update the search journey.

**Second problem: old data**
- Any existing `notes.json` holds strings (the format on `main`).
- With this change, `show("old note")` returns `undefined`, so `notes list` prints `undefined` for every old note. `search` would throw on them as well.
- The PR has no migration or fallback.

**What checks out**
- `npm test` passes: 4 of 4. That matches the PR's claim, but the tests don't cover the broken path.
- By reading the code, both done-criteria should work:
  - `add buy milk --tag home` stores `{text, tag}`, and `show` prints `buy milk #home`.
  - `add call bob` stores `{text}`, and `show` prints `call bob`.
  - I didn't run either one.
- The PR's claim that it is "done and verified" is true only for those two criteria. It doesn't cover the feature as a whole.
- A minor gap: `notes add x --tag` with no value silently adds the note untagged.

**What I couldn't do**
My Bash call to drive the CLI against a temporary `NOTES_FILE` was denied in this session's don't-ask mode, so I didn't retry it another way. If you allow it, I can run the criteria, `search` and the old-format case and save the output under `.verify/`.

**Suggested fix (I changed no code)**
- Make `search` match on `show(n)` or `n.text`.
- Handle string notes when loading or showing them.
- Add a test that searches object notes.

The head passes both done-criteria, but it breaks `notes search` completely and breaks existing note files. Don't merge as is. PR.md says "verified", and that holds only for the two scenarios the author ran.

I pinned the base as `origin/main` (8d62202) and the head as `feat/tags` (6c333ec), and drove the real CLI on each in its own temporary store. The doctor check passed on both. I changed no product code.

| Item | Base | Head | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Criterion 1: `add buy milk --tag home`, then `list` | The tag is not parsed, so it prints `buy milk --tag home` | `buy milk #home` | VERIFIED |
| Criterion 2: `add call bob`, then `list` | `call bob` | `call bob` | VERIFIED |
| `list` with two untagged notes | Both notes, in order | Both notes, in order | VERIFIED |
| `search milk` and `search zebra`, the verify skill's search journey | Prints `buy milk`, then `no matches` | Crashes with `TypeError: n.includes is not a function`, exit 1 | NOT VERIFIED (regression) |
| `search` over a tagged note | Works | Same crash | NOT VERIFIED (regression) |
| `list` on an existing store like `["old note"]` | `old note` | `undefined` | NOT VERIFIED (regression) |

- **Search broken:** `search` in `src/store.js:7` still calls `n.includes(q)` on strings, but notes are now `{text, tag}` objects. Every `search` on a head-created store crashes.
- **Old files break:** the PR changes the storage format with no migration. Any user's existing notes file prints `undefined` on `list`.
- **Why the checks missed it:** `npm test` passes only because the search test feeds in plain strings, so it never exercises the new object format. The author's own verify skill (`.agents/skills/verify-notes/features/search.md`) lists this search journey, and the diff touches `search`'s code path, so it was in scope.
- **Skill edits:** the PR's edit to the verify skill's `add.md` only extends the add journey. It doesn't weaken anything.

Evidence is in `.verify/6c333ec/`: `verdicts.md`, `base.txt` and `head.txt`. That folder is gitignored.

I did not cover tag edge cases such as `--tag` with no value. I also did not post anything on the PR.

Next actions for you:
1. Have the author fix `search` to match on `show(n)` or `n.text`.
2. Have the author handle or migrate string-format notes in `load`.
3. Add tests that run search over object notes and load a legacy file.
